The visual evidence of 'melting' at intersections is a known weakness in AI-generated organic clusters. I agree with Severity 2; it is a noticeable structural ambiguity but not a catastrophic failure. The experts did not contradict this, as their tools have blind spots for subtle internal fusion within a high-confidence mask.
